title: Consumer product claims
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Gather the product's advertised specifications.
3. Identify the specific features or specifications that are claimed by the manufacturer.
4. Compare the documented test results against the advertised specifications.
5. Highlight any discrepancies between the test results and the advertised specifications.
6. Clearly state which advertised specifications were not met.
7. Include details of the testing methodology.
8. Document the environmental conditions under which the tests were conducted.
9. Include information about the testing equipment used and its calibration status.
10. Provide any calculations or analysis that were performed to determine failure.
11. Record any observations made during testing that may have impacted the results.
12. Note the date and time of the failed test.
13. Attach any graphs, charts, or tables that illustrate the failure.
14. Include the serial number, batch number, or any unique identifiers of the product tested.
15. Indicate the number of times the test was conducted and whether failure was consistent.
16. Clarify
